note: The module catalogue the API serves at GET /api/modules. `code` is the value that appears in Exercise.moduleId and Lesson.moduleId. Titles, summaries, tiers and order are curriculum declarations; the corpus in content/lessons and content/exercises is filed under these codes, and a module may be declared before anything is authored under it - it is then served with lessonCount 0 and the tiers it declares, which is the normal way a new module enters the catalogue. targetExerciseCount is the measured size of that module's corpus, not a quota to be reached: GET /api/modules reports exerciseCount for the same module from the loaded corpus, and the two agree because the build fails when they do not. Author the exercises and the count follows; never raise the count ahead of the corpus, or the module page reports a permanent shortfall against a number nothing is working toward.

modules.title: Probability
